meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline: 通过统一API查询多个生物数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在一次工作流中查询多个生物信息数据库
copy.tagline_en: Query multiple bio databases with a unified API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple bioinformatics databases in one workflow

howto.what: 调用 bioservices 包访问约 40 个生物信息学服务,可检索蛋白质、查询通路、搜索化合物、做 ID 映射、跑 BLAST 比对,并返回序列、注释或通路等结果。
howto.when: 当你要在一个工作流里同时查询多个生物数据库(如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等),或想把不同数据库的 ID 互相映射时触发。

say.text: 查一下 ZAP70 蛋白的序列和参与的 KEGG 通路
say.note: 会调用 UniProt 和 KEGG 返回结果。

say.text: 把 KEGG 化合物 C11222 对应到 ChEMBL 的 ID
say.note: 走 UniChem 做跨库映射。

say.text: 用这段蛋白序列跑一次 BLAST 搜索
say.note: 需先设置 NCBI_EMAIL 邮箱。

howto.what_en: Uses the bioservices package to access about 40 bioinformatics services. Claude can retrieve proteins, query pathways, search compounds, map identifiers, and run BLAST, returning sequences, annotations, or pathway data.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you want to query multiple biological databases (e.g., UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL) in one workflow, or to map identifiers across services.

say_en.text: Find the sequence and KEGG pathways for ZAP70 protein.
Map KEGG compound C11222 to its ChEMBL ID.
Run a BLAST search with this protein sequence.
